Package io.vanslog.spring.data.meilisearch.core

Interface ReactiveDocumentOperations

All Known Subinterfaces:
ReactiveMeilisearchOperations
All Known Implementing Classes:
ReactiveMeilisearchTemplate
public interface ReactiveDocumentOperations
Cold, non-blocking document operations. Writes emit or complete only after the corresponding server task succeeds. Cancelling a subscription does not cancel an accepted server task. Collection operations use bounded batches/pages, not an unbounded whole-result buffer.

Junghoon Ban
